Anna K: Quick follow-up from postmortem: I assembled a short triage cookbook + action list for the recent 503/latency spike. Need owners and ETAs by EOD.

Ben M: I can own KV cache eviction analysis. Target 2026-04-05.

Carlos R: I'll handle autoscaler tuning and a small repro load job; will run a canary test Wed.

Lucy W: I'll update the playbook escalation path. Proposal: page infra-sre when thrash >=3x in 10m, include inline triage commands.

Tina (oncall): Agreed on inline commands. Oncall should get the minimal steps in the page so they can act fast.

sre-bot: Created tasks TASK-3510 (eviction), TASK-3511 (autoscaler), TASK-3512 (playbook).

Anna K: Minimal triage snippet to embed:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep model
kubectl -n inference logs <pod> -c inference --tail=200 | grep -i evict || true
curl -s "http://metrics:9090/api/v1/query?query=rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])" | jq .
# if thrash -> /sherlock page infra-sre "Latency thrash >3x, tagging TASK-3510"
```

Anna K: Draft action items: TASK-3510 owner Ben M ETA 2026-04-05; TASK-3511 owner Carlos R ETA 2026-03-31; TASK-3512 owner Lucy W ETA 2026-03-30; TASK-3513 recurrence watch owner Tina (weekly) start 2026-03-30.

Ben M: Will add grep markers and correlate with model-compile jobs.

Carlos R: Will attach canary load script to TASK-3511.

Lucy W: Will PR playbook edits and flag as high-priority so it lands before next rotation.

Tina (oncall): I'll subscribe to the tasks and run the first recurrence check next Tue. Please add a short symptom blurb: "latency increase + 5xx ratio uptick + eviction logs."

Anna K: Added symptom blurb to TASK-3510. Quick sync Mon 09:30 to validate progress. Update tasks and this thread if anything slips. Thanks :thumbsup:
